column1: # How long each workspace crate's tests take, so ci/jobs/rust-scope.sh can split the crates of a
# run over parallel shards. One row per crate: name, tab, seconds. Only the ratios matter (these
# are one machine's wall time for `cargo test -p <crate>` with the golden replay left out). A new
# crate needs a row (crates/repo-tests/tests/ci_scope.rs); a crate without one weighs 30.
